facts: Hashioka made his Bundesliga debut in the match.
He was involved in a collision with Antonio Nusa in the 72nd minute and was removed on a stretcher.
After the match Borussia sporting director Rouven Schroder confirmed that Hashioka was taken to a hospital in Leipzig for medical examination.
Reports described pain in the neck area; no definitive diagnosis was confirmed at this check time.

analysis.text: This is a meaningful status escalation from the earlier confirmed stretcher removal: post-match hospital transfer is now confirmed, while injury diagnosis remains unknown.
